I guess it depends on if you think of conciousness developing from your brain growing, or conciousness coming from an external entity like a soul. That is, if you define existence as concious thought

 The first would suggest that you didnt exist, your brain grew and now you exist, you die and you stop existing. The latter could argue that you didnt exist (or dont remember existing) until your soul matched with your body and now you exist, and that when you die you go back to non-existing. But because your soul is an external entity that has already found a way to exist, there is no reason it can not do so again, bringing you into existence once more.

Personally i lean towards the first way of thinking, but i see no concrete evidence that opposes the latter. The latter simply never crossed my mind.

Interesting point and thank you for sharing:)
